scope: One authored scalar resource-accounting seam check of two AST-extracted functions; no project imports, full study summary, analysis or scientific replay.
runtime_identity_scope: Captured interpreter/version/platform strings and installed distribution version metadata only; no executable or package-content identity, and no agreement with the lockfile was enforced.
counts_and_timing_scope: Execution bookkeeping; no measured research cost, impact or performance evidence.
source_identity_scope: Six authored source/test/configuration/dependency-declaration files; not a project import closure or installed package-content inventory.

execution_seam.method: AST-extract and execute two function definitions using stdlib-only bindings; no project module imports.

resource_contract.unknown: None is unknown; zero is observed.
resource_contract.accepted_values: Exactly native nonnegative int or finite float values, excluding bool and subclasses; storage bytes require int.
resource_contract.sum_policy: Integer-only sums remain exact; any float uses math.fsum with binary64 precision and conversion/overflow limits.
resource_contract.legacy_alias_policy: Four existing aliases read total_if_complete and remain null if any assigned value is unknown.
resource_contract.schema_scope: Fresh producer source contract only; full summary construction and persistence were not executed by this check.
resource_contract.evaluation_missing_cost_policy: Include known costs from every assigned outcome, including evaluation_missing rows.

captured_regression_coverage: Unknown, known-zero, all-unknown, empty and iterator inputs retain distinct counts and nullable totals.
Large integer-only totals remain exact; float summation, mixed conversion overflow and finite-range overflow are checked.
Native numeric type boundary rejects bool, subclasses, spoofed type equality, strings, containers, negative and nonfinite values.
Eight-field adapter retains known costs on evaluation_missing assignments, missing dictionaries/fields and per-field coverage.
Four complete-total aliases, integer-only storage bytes, malformed cost rejection, ignored extra keys and input immutability.
limitations: Availability covers supplied assignments and recorded values only; it does not establish complete instrumentation or lifecycle coverage.
If fit_options raises before returning, local options remains empty and fit_seconds_all_options can report zero despite attempted fitting; unchanged by this patch.
Option timers are nested in fit/selection/materialization; native, binary64, verification and export timers are nested in heldout workflow and are not additive to enclosing timers.
Current timer samples exclude some later persistence, scans and hashing; storage is an immediate-file scan before the current outcome write.
No producer execution, full summarize_main, JSON persistence, analyze_study, lineage loading, study replay or scientific artifact execution.
analyze_study remains deferred; no historical summaries, failed work, scientific outcomes or earlier receipt scopes are recovered or rewritten.
Cold acquisition/preparation/encoding, memory/energy, model/device coverage and full inference maintenance remain incomplete.
Runtime continuity concerns captured strings and installed version metadata, not interpreter executable or package-content identity or lockfile agreement.
No measured research cost, full lifecycle total, amortization crossover, cost advantage, causal usefulness or business-impact claim.
Documentation snippets remain unexecuted; recorded test does not verify later documentation/publication edits or hosted CI.

publication.scope: Retained identities and publication baselines checked with stdlib and read-only Git; no project execution.
